notes.title: Bless Online v1.0.0.1 EA release spec notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/eb2860a35909b1e9ffec4ea9ddee7abac5d164a5.jpg[/img]
The Bless Online v1.0.0 EA version will be released on May 30, 2018.
The key specs of Bless Online v1.0.0.1 EA are given below.

[h1][b][Basic information][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Levels and Character Creation[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]The maximum level is level 45.
[*]Each server supports 4 free character slots, plus 2 additional slots unlockable with Lumena.
[*]Character and guild names must be between 2-12 characters. Names can only contain alphabetical characters and digits.
[*]Basic inventory has 48 slots + 16 additional slots available through quests or are unlockable with Lumena.
[/list]

[i][b]Races and Classes[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Classes: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Factions and races:
[list]
[*]Unión: Amistad, Pantera, Aqua Elf, Mascu
[*]Hieron: Habicht, Lupus, Sylvan Elf, Mascu
[/list]
[*]Selectable classes by race
[list]
[*]Amistad/Habicht: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Pantera/Lupus: Guardian, Berserker, Ranger
[*]Aqua Elf/Sylvan Elf: Guardian, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[*]Mascu: Guardian, Berserker, Paladin, Mage, Ranger
[/list]
[*]Selectable targeting modes by class
[list]
[*]Tab-targeting: Mage, Ranger, Paladin, Guardian
[*]Action-targeting: Berserker
[/list]
[/list]

[i][b]Major Currencies[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Dungeon Points: These can be obtained from dungeons and Hunt Quests.
[*]Combat Points: These can be obtained from PVP combat or other PVP content.
[*]Gold: This can be obtained from monster hunting and quests. 
[*]Lumena: This can be obtained by exchanging Dungeon Points and/or Combat Points, or purchased with cash.
[/list]

[h1][b][Quests][/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/068cfe441a4b48fdf0c22d36780e7be30d9d1691.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial Zone & The Pathfinder of Adventure[/b]
[list]A separate training ground for beginners. Users can learn how to use the Bless interface, key systems, and content, and claim rewards. [/list]
[*][b]The Footprints of Destiny (Main Quests)[/b]
[list]The Footprints of Destiny is the main story quest line in Bless, and is based on the faction and race of your character. As the story grows along with your character, it is necessary to follow this quest. [/list]
[*][b]Memories of Journey (Side Quests)[/b]
[list]The Memories of Journey are episodic quests that can be carried out in different regions. These additional stories are separate from the main Bless storyline, allowing you to experience various episodes that took place throughout the continent through memories of the past. [/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 10.[/i][/list]
[*][b]Hunt Quests[/b]
[list]These are quests to hunt a certain number of a particular monster type. Complete these quests to earn Dungeon Points.[/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 10.[/i][/list]
[*][b]Missions[/b]
[list]Missions are performance goals which can be completed on a daily or weekly basis. Completing them will grant EXP and rewards. The progress goals and rewards are different depending on the character level. [/list]
[list][i]*Can be performed from Character Level 7.[/i][/list]
[/list]

[h1][b][PVP content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Combat Class[/b][/i]
Depending on your PvP results and your contribution to battle, you will acquire EXP and Combat Points. Merit is determined by the Combat Points earned by the character over the past seven days, and Combat Class is calculated by comparing the Merit earned over the past 4 weeks with the determined Merit. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5eb7aaa340aaf186abc9041d0c153e58b7d78593.jpg[/img]
[i]* Combat Class compensation for Combat Points: Every Tuesday at 1:00 AM[/i]
[i]* You can obtain Gem Fragments when using medals.[/i]


[h1][b][PVE content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Field Bosses [/b][/i]
In the open field, there are boss monsters that require 20 Raid Party members to defeat. They appear in one of 7 neutral areas in an 18-hour cycle.
* Appearance areas: Wyvern Valley 1, Wyvern Valley 2, Dustbowl, White Desert, Vachel, Wyvern Valley 3, North of Saltus
    
[i][b]Dungeons[/b][/i]
There are dungeons throughout the Bless world where you can battle powerful monsters that are difficult to encounter in the field. You can enter these dungeons if you have the required level and Gear Score.
[i]* Dungeon Play Count will be reset every day at 1:00 AM. [/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ca0d35660d0b8d02dbba05c218acdac17cf65e0c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][Non-combat content][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Companions [/b][/i]
Around 600 tamable monsters inhabit the world of Bless. 
Depending on your character and Taming level, you'll be able to tame up to 200 monsters.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/f7dbc10bdd8697e636d2d1fac5e8fc711b9b3a86.jpg[/img]

You can obtain mounts and pets via taming. You can try to tame most monsters in the field, and you can improve them through Upgrading and Enhancement once the monster is successfully tamed.  
[list]
[*][b]Taming Method[/b]
[list]You can start a Taming mini-game by using an appropriate Taming Scroll on the target monster. You will acquire a new Companion if you succeed. There is a small chance of a Great Success mini-game occurring, allowing you to acquire a higher level Companion depending on the probability of success.[/list]

[i][b]Enhancement and Upgrading[/b][/i]
[list]You can increase the EXP of pets and mounts by Enhancement. Whenever a pet's EXP gauge reaches 100%, the pet's level increases by 1. When you reach the maximum level in each grade, you can increase the grade of pets and mounts through Upgrading, in the order [b][Magical] - [Rare] - [Heroic] - [Legendary][/b]. [/list]
[/list]

[i][b]Gathering/Mining[/b][/i]
You can acquire items for crafting through gathering and mining. You'll need a Gathering Bag to gather plants, and a Pickaxe to mine ore.
[list][*]Let's Gather Dungeon: A single player dungeon that allows you to collect minerals, grain, etc. freely for a limited time. You can enter the dungeon via 'Rand Brother Turban', who appears randomly in the fields of Bless.[/list]

[i][b]Crafting[/b][/i]
You can craft a new item using materials and recipes acquired through various routes.
The crafting system is classified as below, and 1 skill in each category can be selected.
[list]
[*]Main Crafting: Armorsmithing, Handiwork, Enchanting
[*]Sub Crafting: Secret, Cooking, Alchemy 
[/list]
You can use workshops or universal workbenches for crafting. Every time you craft, your Craft Points increase. The higher your Craft Points, the higher your crafting level. A higher crafting level provides more crafting benefits.


[h1][b][Combat skills][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Skill Growth [/b][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/f85bc7e095d00f58263d8b3e7173e04e074e712a.jpg[/img]
You can choose 2 Stance-Chain Skills and 4 Non-Chain skills to perform combat moves. You can choose whether to continue the Stance-Chain skill's 3 to 4 combo sets to maintain the skill's enhanced effects, or use Non-Chain skills to obtain instant utility.

Skill types are divided as follows, 
[list]
[*]Stance: A state that can be assumed during battle. Effects are granted according to Stance duration and conversion. It includes the Stance-Chain Skill that follows the sequence of Starting Skill > Link Skill > Finish Skill.
[*]Non-Chain skill: Utility skill immediately available regardless of stance state. 
[/list]
[i][b]Skill Acquisition and Growth System[/b][/i]
Characters can automatically acquire skills according to their level.     
Skill growth is possible via Gem items.
There are three types of Gems, which can be obtained through the leveling process. Gems can be assembled from the 'Gem Fragment' item, obtained from quests and field monsters.

There are three types of Gems – Stance-Chain, Non-Chain, and parameter – and these are used to grow skill nodes of each type.     
    

[h1][b][Items][/b][/h1]

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/428996a27b838f0b8761b6dd7a645cf305e67717.jpg[/img]
Items are categorized into 6 ratings: Misc, Common, Magical, Rare, Heroic, and Legendary; the higher the rating, the higher its ability and effect. Items can be upgraded and managed.
[list]
[*][b]Equipment Enhancement/Transcended Enhancement[/b]
You can strengthen your equipment with Equipment Enhancement Machines found in the capital of each faction. As well as the equipment to be enhanced, you'll need Enhancement materials and Enhancement sub-materials. Enhancement failure can result in loss of enhancement materials, and a decrease in the Enhancement step and maximum durability of the equipment. 
When the Enhancement step reaches 15, you can attempt Transcended Enhancement in order to add a special option or a Spirit slot in addition to increased ability.
[*][b]Equipment Succession[/b]
Transcended Enhancements in equipment can be transferred to higher-level equipment through enhancement succession. Succession will transfer the Transcended level to the new item, but there is a chance that the Enhancement level will be reduced. You will need an additional Essential Material to perform a Succession.
[*][b]Equipment Repair/Durability[/b]
Weapons and armor have a durability which is reduced in the following cases. Reduced durability can be restored via repair tools or blacksmith NPCs in a capital city or camp. However, the maximum durability may be reduced if an Enhancement or repair attempt fails.
[*][b]Dismantling Items[/b]
Certain items, including equipment, can be dismantled via Dismantling Machines found in various locations. Dismantling an item can yield various items depending on the item classification and Enhancement state.
[*][b]Spirits[/b]
You can increase your character's ability by imbuing your armor with a Spirit. Spirits are divided into offensive and defensive types, and each of them has 3 levels. Spirits added to armor can be destroyed in the following situations.
[/list]
[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9e9aaf0d4e3e3c63aa4f475623eca2b82a4fce6d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1][b][Major communities][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Friends [/b][/i]
You can add characters to your friends list if they are members of the same faction.
If they are registered as friends, it is easier to check their online status, chat and form a party. 

[i][b]Parties/Party Effects[/b][/i]
Players from the same faction can form a party of up to 5 members. Party members can raid dungeons together, or kill monsters too difficult to face alone. Also, if you play in a party, you can benefit from combat and lifestyle buff effects.

[i][b]Raid Parties[/b][/i]
A party extension feature that supports up to 20 players in deploying effective tactics together.
When a party is formed, the party leader can switch it to a Raid Party.

[i][b]Guilds[/b][/i]
A guild is a group of people who want to make friends and share the same goals in the game. You can create or join a guild under certain conditions. Guilds can be created via the guild manager NPC located in towns or villages belonging to each faction. When creating a guild, you must apply as a party with 1 or more other players who are not already members of a guild (2 or more players in total including yourself).
[list][*]Guild Influence/Guild Level
You can gain Guild Influence through the specific activities of guild members. The total accumulated Guild Influence represents the Guild Experience, and the Guild Level increases based on Guild Experience. Guild Influence is updated daily at 1:00 AM and automatically disappears if the guild is disbanded.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/9e4e4e1497c211669642af9923cbdb1491a6eb4a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][Main features][/b][/h1]

[i][b]Market[/b][/i]
A place where you can sell items to other players or purchase items you need.
You can view the market products in the system menu, but to actually buy/sell items, you'll need to visit Sarara, the market manager NPC, in the capital of either faction.
You can enter any price within the standard price range for each item, with an upper and lower limit of 25%. The basic sales tax rate is 15%.
Items purchased with Lumena, items with the "not for trade" attribute, and pet/mount items cannot be traded.

[i][b]Special Currency Shop[/b][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/5b79385fe2a2b6bd38165d96fe8a12761bde91b9.jpg[/img]
In the Special Currency Shop, you can purchase various items using Bless currencies such as Lumena and Activity Points (Combat Points and Dungeon Points). Purchased items can be found in the inventory.
-	Lumena Category: Character costumes/mount/pet appearance changes, functional extensions, convenience items, etc.
-	Combat Point Category: Regular items, equipment succession, Enhancement-related material items, etc.
-	Dungeon Point Category: Enhancement sub-material items for pets and mounts 

[i][b]Lumena Exchange[/b][/i]
Activity Points (Combat Points and Dungeon Points) can be exchanged for up to 50 Lumena a day.

[i][b]Account Inbox/Mail[/b][/i]
You can check the acquired items from the Steam Inventory via your Account Inbox. When you receive an item from the Account Inbox, it will be moved to mail. Once you receive the item from your mail, you will see it in the inventory window. 
You can exchange items between characters on the same account via the mailbox. All items that can be registered on the market are attachable. 
 
[i][b]Personal Warehouses[/b][/i]
You can use a personal warehouse for each character in your account, where you can store up to 48 items.
Personal warehouses can be accessed via personal warehouse managers located in the large cities of each faction.

notes.title: Information on Bless Online Founder’s Pack
notes.content:
With the start of Bless Online’s Early Access on May 30th, 3 different Founder’s Pack DLC will be available for sale starting May 28th at 10:00 (PDT), 17:00 (UTC). [b]All the Founder’s Packs include the base game and a 2 day head start on it on May 28th.[/b]

We will also be providing a guide which includes an explanation on each DLC, as well as the items they each include and useful information for all those players who have been waiting for Bless Online!
Make sure to keep reading if you want to experience the magical world of Bless Online!

You can purchase the Founder’s Pack DLC through the links below!
[list]
    [*] Standard Edition ($39.99)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811210/Bless_Online_Founders_Pack__Standard_Edition/] [/url]
    [*] Deluxe Edition ($69.99)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/855170/Bless_Online_Founders_Pack__Deluxe_Edition/] [/url]
    [*] Collector’s Edition ($149.99)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811170/Bless_Online_Founders_Pack__Collectors_Edition/] [/url]
[/list]

[list][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/69a20cf28f82f8435048196acb49138874d6abae.jpg[/img][/list]

The [b]Standard Edition[/b] was made for players who want to play Bless Online and get DLC contents at an affordable price, and includes the following contents::
(Make sure to read the detailed information on each item at the end of this post!)
[list]
    [*] Advanced Access (Bless Online game + access to Bless 2 days prior to Early Access)
    [*] Premium Membership (30 days)
[/list]

[list][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2c0a26e45b1e394addc50ddb81ec4584d559ff63.jpg[/img][/list]

The [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] was made for players who want to get a more special and convenient Bless experience, and includes the following contents:
(Make sure to read the detailed information on each item at the end of this post!)
[list]
    [*] Advanced Access (Bless Online game + access to Bless 2 days prior to Early Access)
    [*] Premium Membership (60 days)
    [*] Lumena (2,450)
    [*] Exclusive Mount Skin (Frosty White Regulus)
    [*] Exclusive Pet Skin (Frosty White Ningo)
[/list]

[list][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/d0d8f7766158548f81c8788c621ca76875e81467.jpg[/img][/list]

The [b]Collector’s Edition[/b] was made for players who want to keep a close eye on how the game continues to grow. It also ensures a wide range of exclusive benefits (such as credit titles) to players who want to contribute to Bless Online’s development.
The Collector’s Edition includes the following contents:
(Make sure to read the detailed information on each item at the end of this post!)
[list]
    [*] Advanced Access (Bless Online game + access to Bless 2 days prior to Early Access)
    [*] Credits Title “The Founder”
    [*] Game Code (One gift copy of Bless Online)
    [*] Premium Membership (90 days)
    [*] Lumena (3,800)
    [*] Exclusive Costume Skin (Frozen Glacialis Costume)
    [*] Exclusive Weapon Skin (The Glacialis Weapon skin)
    [*] Exclusive Mount Skin (Frosty White Regulus)
    [*] Exclusive Pet Skin (Frosty White Ningo)
    [*] Twinkling Wing effect
[/list]

Have you decided on a specific Founder’s Pack?
No worries, you can find a detailed explanation on each item below to help you make up your mind!
[list]
    [*] [b]Advanced Access[/b] 
You can start playing Bless 2 days before Early Access starts! Everyone who purchases DLCs can get a head start on the Bless adventure on May 28th!
Don’t miss out on the DLCs if you wanna experience the world of Bless before every else!

    [*] [b]Credits Title “The Founder” (Included only in Collector’s Edition!)[/b]
Through Credits title, your name will be added to Neowiz Bless Studios’ credits list as a member of “The Founder”. You can check your name by clicking on the “credit” button on the Bless main screen when Bless Online is officially released.

    [*] [b]Game Code (Included only in Collector’s Edition!)[/b]
 You’ll get a Bless Online game code that you can later give to one friend.

    [*] [b]Premium Membership[/b]
Users who obtain Premium Membership will get premium mount and pet skins, in-game items, in-game buffs, and other special perks. [b]Each DLC offers benefits for a specific period of time depending on the type of Founder’s Pack (30, 60 or 90 days).[/b] 
The premium membership’s time-limited buff effects will be applied to each region, therefore all characters created in a single region will be able to enjoy the same buff effects.

These benefits include:
[list]
[*] Premium mount skin (Black Wind Caligo) 
[*] Premium pet skin (Enchanting Loroshi)
[*] Reduces NPC equipment repair fee by 30%
[*] Reduces Wyvern usage fee by 50%
You can explore the world of Bless by paying a fee to any of the Wyvern handlers found in each city and town and riding a Wyvern.
[*] Pickaxe
Unlimited Pickaxe uses, an in-game item needed for Mining.
[*] Gathering Bag
Unlimited Gathering Bag uses, an in-game item needed for Gathering. 
[*] Adds 20% more Hunting experience points
[*] Acquires 20% more Dungeon points
[*] Adds 20% hunting gold bonus
[*] Allows 5 more items to be registered on the market
[*] Reduces market tax by 10%
[*] Increases daily activity point exchange amount by 20%
You may exchange your daily obtained amount of Dungeon Points and Combat Points for in-game currency or Lumenas.[/list]

    [*] [b]Lumena[/b]
Lumena is in-game currency that can be obtained when playing Bless contents.

    [*] [b]Exclusive Costume and Weapon Skins (Included only in Collector’s Edition!)[/b]
The Frozen Glacialis costume and the Glacialis Weapon skins make the character stand out even from Level 1.
These premium costumes and skins offered as part of the Founder’s Pack won’t be available at the Lumena store later on nor obtainable as DLCs or through future events.

    [*] [b]Exclusive Costume and Weapon Skins[/b]
Make the monsters you tamed look cooler and more colorful with the Frosty White Regulus and Frosty Wind Ningo skins, available when purchasing the Deluxe and Collector’s Edition.
These premium costumes and skins offered as part of the Founder’s Pack won’t be available at the Lumena store later on nor obtainable as DLCs or through future events.

    [*] [b]Twinkling Wing Effect (Included only in Collector’s Edition!)[/b]
When triggered, this effect makes your character stand out by giving them twinkling wings for five seconds. This Twinkling Wing effect can be used continuously but has a cool-down time.[/list]


[h1]To apply purchased DLC products in-game, please follow the steps below:[/h1]
[olist]
    [*] Access Bless and choose the character that will receive the DLC products.
    [*] Open your account inbox.
    [*] The In-Game Buff set, one of the Premium Membership benefits, [b]will be applied to your account immediately[/b] once you accept it from your account inbox.
    [*] Items will be bundled in one package, and [b]automatically sent to your character’s mailbox[/b] upon receipt.
    [*] Once you accept the items in your mailbox, the item will automatically be added to the inventory of the character you used to accept the item.	
If it is an expiring item, the item’s remaining usage time will start counting down once you open the item’s packaging in your inventory.
[/olist]

[h1]Note:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] There is no product that allows users to upgrade or downgrade between DLCs. Meaning a founder’s pack standard edition cannot be upgraded to a deluxe edition, nor can a collector’s edition cannot be downgraded to a standard edition etc., Therefore please purchase the correct DLC product!
    [*] Receiving temporary in-game items (Pickaxe, Gathering Bag) when purchasing DLC in a character’s inventory and purchasing additional identical items won’t duplicate the items’ limited usage time. These items will be consumed at the same time. 
The buff effect obtained through premium membership will be combined if an extra identical buff effect is applied.
    [*] The mount and pet skins available with the Deluxe and Collector’s Edition can be seen after applying the skins to [b]already summoned mount or pets.[/b] You won’t be able to see the skins on unsummoned mounts or pets. Characters can attempt to tame monsters after learning how to tame monsters naturally as they level up and after creating a Taming scroll or purchasing it on the market.
    [*] The Credits title available with the Collector’s Edition will be available with the other Collector’s Edition items [b]when the player logs into Bless Online for the first time after Advanced Access.[/b] The character’s information will be added to the credits list on Bless Online’s official release date.
    [*] The Bless Online gift copy available with the Collector’s Edition will be sent to your Steam inventory, and cannot be sent to players located in countries where Bless Online is not available through the Steam Platform.
    [*] The Exclusive Weapon Skin (Glacialis Weapon skin) available with the Collector’s Edition will be given to the character [b]as a weapon that corresponds to their specific class.[/b]
[/list]

- Once you accept the items in your mailbox, the item will automatically be added to the inventory of the character you used to accept the item.
- If it is an expiring item, the item’s remaining usage time will start counting down once you open the item’s packaging in your inventory.

- There is no product that allows users to upgrade or downgrade between DLCs. Meaning a founder’s pack standard edition cannot be upgraded to a deluxe edition, nor can a collector’s edition cannot be downgraded to a standard edition etc., Therefore please purchase the correct DLC product!

- Receiving temporary in-game items (Pickaxe, Gathering Bag) when purchasing DLC in a character’s inventory and purchasing additional identical items won’t duplicate the items’ limited usage time. These items will be consumed at the same time.
- The buff effect obtained through premium membership will be combined if an extra identical buff effect is applied.

- The mount and pet skins available with the Deluxe and Collector’s Edition can be seen after applying the skins to already summoned mount or pets. You won’t be able to see the skins on unsummoned mounts or pets.
- The Credits title available with the Collector’s Edition will be available with the other Collector’s Edition items when the player logs into Bless Online for the first time after Advanced Access.

- The Bless Online gift copy available with the Collector’s Edition will be sent to your Steam inventory, and cannot be sent to players located in countries where Bless Online is not available through the Steam Platform.
- The Exclusive Weapon Skin (Glacialis Weapon skin) available with the Collector’s Edition will be given to the character as a weapon that corresponds to their specific class.

notes.title: Preview Event Community Q&A
notes.content:
Greetings!

First and foremost, we want to let everyone know that community feedback is very important to our developers, and accordingly, we are always open to your opinions. Therefore as a response to the questions received about our recent “Early Access Announcement” post, we have prepared the following Q&A.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/60528d91e4d6f1748ca06d03380ac00d060e4ce9.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]How does pricing work in different countries with different currencies?[/b][/h1]
[i] A:  Prices for different countries and currencies are set individually, and won't necessarily be equivalent to the USD price.[/i]


[h1][b]What is included in the Founder’s Packs?[/b][/h1]

[h1]Q: We want more information on the founder’s packs. [/h1]
[i]A: Founder's packs will include the Bless Online base game, exclusive skins, premium membership, Lumena, and other benefits.
The content of all the founder's packs include the base game, and purchasers can expect around a 31-33% discount from what the price would be if all the components were purchased individually.[/i]

[h1]Q: Is the premium membership subscription based? What are the benefits? [/h1] 
[i]A: Premium membership is not a subscription-based product. Premium membership can help increase efficiency or provide an effect that will, for a limited amount of time, reduce the costs of convenience related fees. As anyone with the base game can enjoy all of Bless’ content without restriction, premium membership can be seen as an option for those who want a more convenient gameplay experience. As we are aware of your concerns regarding P2W, there will be no items that can directly enhance characters or items.

The following are details regarding premium membership. They are applied to all characters in a region within the specified time period. (exception: skins may only belong to one character)
[list]
[*]Premium mount skin (Black Wind Caligo) 
[*]Premium pet skin (Enchanting Loroshi) 
[*]Reduces NPC equipment repair fee by 30%
[*]Reduces Wyvern usage fee by 50 %: Players can travel to any area within Bless by paying the Wyvern manager (located in each village/city) gold for Wyvern transportation.
[*]Pickaxe: This premium pickaxe used for Gathering provides unlimited usage within the designated time period, whereas the regular pickaxe has a limited number of uses.
[*]Gathering Bag: This premium bag used for Gathering provides unlimited usage within the designated time period, whereas the regular gathering bag has a limited number of uses. 
[*]Acquires 20% more hunting experience points: Increased amount of experience points earned through hunting monsters.
[*]Acquires 20% more Dungeon points: Increased amount of dungeon points earned through playing dungeons.
[*]Adds 20% hunting gold bonus: Increased amount of gold earned through hunting monsters.
[*]Allows 5 more items to be registered in the market: Increased amount of items registerable on the market.
[*]Reduces market tax by 10%: Reduced market tax rate.
[*]Increases daily activity point exchange amount by 20%: The amount of exchanges allowed per day within the in-game system, Exchange Office, is increased. The Exchange Office is an in-game feature where players can exchange a specific amount of their dungeon and combat points (earned through in-game activities) into Lumena. It is exchangeable regardless of whether you purchase the premium membership or not. The Lumena that one obtains through exchanges is an in-game currency with which players can purchase a variety of items in the store. 
[/list]
Premium mount/pet skins are characteristic appearance skins included only in the premium membership. As they are cosmetics, purchasers will not obtain any secondary benefit from its usage (They are also untradeable and cannot be dismantled).[/i]

[h1]Q: What do the exclusive skins look like? Do they have any secondary effects?[/h1]
[i]A: We now present to you the founder’s packs’ exclusive skins!
Skins will only have cosmetic functions and will not have any secondary effects that can be obtained through its usage(they are also untradable and cannot be dismantled).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/6e61beda5d4428081bcacc16b1823667f61133d1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/e82c837707552d7aad5870560dea4c4a6bba75c3.jpg[/img]
A weapon skin matching the class of the receiving character will be given(for example, if the item is received by a guardian character, a single-handed sword and shield will be given).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2d6a10d9d2f10024bf26a670da019bbec3e916c6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2c048e78e5735ed162df4b7eeb5e0b94ec72a427.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/eed37dd62cd82cd59b53a07351eae4d485d3e5ff.jpg[/img][/i]

[h1]Q: So about that Collector’s Edition… Tell us more about things such as the credits title and gift copy.[/h1]
[i]A: Credits Title: "The Founder"
This feature allows for the purchaser’s name to appear in Neowiz’s Bless Online credits list under the section titled "The Founder." Purchasers can find their names by clicking on "Credit" in the game lobby screen upon the official release of the game. [/i]

[h1]Q: How can we use the gift copy included in the Collector’s Edition? Does the recipient also get a 2 days head start? [/h1]
[i]A: The gift copy is a feature that allows you to gift a friend with a base game code (delivered to the purchaser’s Steam inventory). There is no head start included in the base game code as that is only a benefit provided to founder’s pack purchasers. [/i]

[h1]Q: Can you gift components of the collector’s edition to a friend? [/h1]
[i]A: Purchasers of the Collector’s Edition will receive a game code that can be gifted to a friend. However, game items from the pack cannot be gifted.[/i] 

[h1]Q: What is premium customer service? Does that mean that you won’t be assisting normal players? [/h1]
[i]A: Premium customer service was a feature designed for purchasers of the collector’s edition to receive exceptional support. However, as a direct response to user feedback, the Bless Team has decided to remove this feature and provide service to all our users equally regardless of the pack or game that they purchased.

[u]Premium customer service has been removed from the list of benefits.[/u][/i]

[h1]Q: The price of the Collector’s Edition though...[/h1]
[i]A: As explained above, the founder’s packs contain things such as exclusive skins, Lumena, and additional products that are non-P2W. However, we have received user feedback that the Collector’s Edition is overly expensive. As a result, the Bless Team has decided to adjust the price from $199.99 to $149.99 so that the pack is more accessible for all. 

[u]The Founder’s Pack - Collector’s Edition will be sold at $149.99 instead of $199.99. (We will adjust previous price announcements to state the new price of $149.99)[/u][/i]



[h1][b]Regarding the Early Access Version of the Game[/b][/h1]

[h1]Q: What are the benefits of being in a guild?[/h1]
[i]A: Depending on the guild's influence, there are special items that guild members can buy. It is also one of the few ways to obtain flying mounts. [/i]

[h1]Q: What can players gain by doing faction PvP? [/h1]
[i]A: By dueling within your faction, or engaging in PvP with the opposition faction, players can gain combat points. Using combat points (activity points), players can buy items at the special currency shop.[/i]

[h1]Q: Is there any plan for a non-PvP server? If not, why? [/h1]
[i]A: No! As Bless has both PvP and PvE content, players can play the game however they like without needing to have separate servers. [/i]

[h1]Q: Is there a PvP avoidance item? If yes, what are the details and how can we get it? [/h1]
[i]A: Yes! There is. Before reaching the max level (45) players can use gold to purchase Peace Declaration item, and the effect will last for around 10 minutes. After reaching max level, players can use Lumena to purchase the Peace Pledge item instead. [/i]

[h1]Q: Will there be a dungeon re-set item? [/h1]
[i]A: Although they do exist, we do not plan to sell it for cash.[/i]

[h1]Q: Do costumes (mount, pet, equipment, and weapons skins) have any secondary effects?[/h1]
[i]A: No, they are just skins. Costumes released in the future will also only be skins and nothing more. They also cannot be dismantled, meaning players cannot obtain enhancement items by dismantling costumes. [/i]

[h1]Q: Will there be Player to Player trading?[/h1]
[i]A: No there will not. Aside from the in-game auction house, there is no feature that allows player-to-player trading as we do not want a black market.[/i] 



[h1][b]What are the plans for updates like?[/b][/h1]

[h1]Q: Is there playable content accessible by purchasing additional DLC? Will DLC be added when there are new class updates (e.g. assassin)? [/h1]
[i]A: We do not expect purchasers to buy DLC as we have no plans to sell updated content as DLC. For example, content updates that will include the assassin and mystic will be able to be fully enjoyed just with the purchase of the base game.[/i]

[h1]Q: How often can updates be expected?[/h1]
[i]A: Although we plan to update the game every month, big updates can be expected around every 3 months. For example, we plan to add the assassin class for the first big update. Afterward, new classes, level increases, and new battlefield content can be expected in similarly sized updates. [/i]


As we approach the Early Access date even more information will be provided. 

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Dev Talk #03] Key Changes in Bless Online’s Steam Release
notes.content:
Greetings!

As we march towards the May release of Bless Online on Steam, many of you asked how the Steam version of Bless Online is going to be different from its past or currently available releases. We definitely understand where the questions are coming from. We have not shared as much as we should have in explaining how the game will be different from what you see in Korea or Japan servers. That’s why we decided to focus this blog on describing some of the key changes we are bringing to the Steam release. 

While we’ve been developing Bless Online for a long time, our focus on making Bless Online a great game has never wavered. We also have an amazing and active community that has not given up on us but continue to support us and give constructive feedback. One of the primary goals for the Steam release is to make sure to address some of the key concerns that have been repeatedly raised by the community. Now, let’s explore what some of those changes are.

[h1]Combat System Restructuring[/h1]
[b][u]Let’s change everything we can![/u][/b]
We spent the most effort in revamping the combat system! We’ve re-examined almost every class’ skills and restructured their composition and effects.

[b]Rhythmic Combat[/b]
[list]
[*]Players need to pick two stance skills out of six, as well as four general skills that will go well with their class. Using these skills in combos during combat will lead to extra effects (1. Select a stance, 2. Use your starting skill 3. Use a skill combo).

[*]In combat, there is more action and it has gotten more difficult due to the new dynamic combo system. Depending on how good a player is at making combos, they can bring out the full potential of their class.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/4e2ae5d59ac5501d96deeef2d60e27332c4c30a8.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[b]Restructuring Growth Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*]We have rebuilt the mechanics behind both skill acquisition and skill leveling. In the Steam version, in addition to advancing your equipment, learning and leveling up skills are main parts of growing your character.  

[*]There is a variety of ways to obtain the gems that are used to level skills. As we aim to avoid P2W, the amount of money you spend on the game will not affect the amount of gems you can get.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ae94978d5557eca0fae4bed8fcffecffd371f684.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[h1]Party Buffs[/h1]
[b][u]Join a party for the full Bless experience![/u][/b]
[list]
[*]We believe that the best way to enjoy any MMORPG is by playing with others. As an incentive for players to play the game with a variety of people, we have decided to introduce party benefits!

[*]Depending on the number of members, classes, and races of the party members, the party leader can choose one combat effect and one lifestyle (non-combat) effect from a selection to be applied to party members! 

[*]With this feature we hope that not only those who enjoy combat, but also those who prefer the lifestyle (non-combat) aspects of MMORPGs can enjoy playing with other players! 

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/ea75e40969c5dadf6314d8ee9932137879aeea7b.jpg[/img]
[i] (The screenshots above were taken during the development process and therefore are not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[h1]User Friendly Monetization[/h1]
[b][u]Everyone will love our in-game shops![/u][/b]
Along with having no P2W in the Steam version, Bless Online’s monetization system will be user friendly. 
[list] 

[*]Content token shop: We have designed it so that players can use content tokens (special in-game currency earned by just playing the game) to purchase functional items.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/b9e6a64c502d8006a895dce61e1e8fb979c7e5c2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Lumena shop: Players can use Lumena (in-game currency purchased using real money) to buy a variety of  convenience and cosmetic items.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/33a801c46e85f8e32549345ee4d05897ffb31f58.jpg[/img]
[i](The screenshot above was taken during the development process and therefore is not localized nor reflective of the final product.) [/i]

[list]
[*]Also, with the addition of the Lumena Exchange Center (name is WIP), players will be able to convert their content tokens into Lumena. This feature will allow even players who only buy the game (and nothing more!) the ability to use the Lumena shop to purchase convenience and cosmetic items.

[/list]

[h1]The Upgraded Bless Experience [/h1]
[b][u]A better paced path for Bless![/u][/b]

[b]Tutorial Zone[/b]
[list]

[*]Many new players reported that they did not have the best experience playing Bless due to the game being designed with experienced MMORPG players in mind. 

[*]In the Steam version, there will be a new area specifically for new players to practice basic skills. Those who are experienced MMORPG players or who already know the basics can skip this, but even if you skip or complete the tutorial, you can always go back to it.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/42c17c34e3614677cb31c3247cfb5aa02cb3f62c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/1c01e46e1d82903c0141aeb1632f59156536f380.jpg[/img]

[b]Guide Quests [/b]
[list]
[*]These quests will teach you things the tutorial does not.
[*]They are much easier to understand than the pre-existing introductory quests.
[/list]

[b]Improved Content Pacing[/b]
[list]
[*]In Bless, players can take part in most activities even if they are only level 1. As a result, some new users reported difficulty in knowing where they are supposed to start.
[*]To address this, we have improved the pacing at which users are exposed to new content so that they can adjust to Bless in stages instead of being overwhelmed right from the beginning.
[/list]

[b]Upgraded Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*]In Bless, players level up through PvE combat and by experiencing a variety of events. As much of the PvE combat was relatively easy and repetitive, most players were quickly bored.
[*]In order to solve this problem, we have updated the mobs with special skills. We are also currently developing more features that will make leveling up an exciting adventure!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/29ae8bacb3bd14ef898bdeebfc8144d463b10a43.jpg[/img]
We are hopeful that these changes will allow our players to further enjoy Bless Online and have an exceptional overall experience. If you are interested in testing these key features for yourself, make sure you don’t miss Bless Online’s early access in May!  

Thank you,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Inside Snacks] Introducing the Food of Bless Online
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Now that you know Early Access for Bless Online will be coming this May(!!), the next question on your mind is probably, [u]“how do I keep myself healthy and nourished during that time??”[/u] We know that balancing gaming with consuming proper nutrients can be a tough challenge. In light of this, we would like to introduce to you some new products: a line of Bless snacks!

[list]
[*][h1]Bless-O’s[/h1]
[*]Perfect for both Early Access and early morning gaming, Bless-O’s are not only jam packed with fiber and 7 essential vitamins and minerals, but also have 18 grams of sugar per serving to keep you energized and focused on leveling all day long!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/d872f796f4da298275e09ac04b45f9f5d870797e.jpg[/img]

[*][h1]Pantera Puffs[/h1]
[*]For times when a party member causes your whole group to wipe, or when you fail to tame a pet for the third time in a row, Pantera Puffs are there! The satisfying and cheesy crunch of each puff will help you channel your frustration into supplying your body with much needed carbs and protein!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/0b708985300a94b4e8391f1561ad420245f29639.jpg[/img]
[/list]
We hope you will look forward to enjoying these delicious Bless snacks ;)

Cheers,
The Bless Team

notes.title: Business Model and…Early Access?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/641de2314b9382f9436cd85bfb68c2ae2837293b.jpg[/img]

[h1]There have been many questions regarding Bless Online’s business model. We would like to answer the most important questions for you now![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/d1fc35b047752dfbd25f893e844d029138f462aa.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b] Q. What is Bless Online’s business model?[/b]
[*] A. Bless Online will be an early access game on Steam, and it will be released as [b][u]Buy-to-Play[/u][/b], meaning you will buy the game and play it as long as you want with no monthly fees. The final price will be confirmed at a later date. 
 
[*][b] Q. Will there be an in-game store? Will it be Pay-To-Win???[/b]
[*] A. Yes, there will be an in-game store! We will offer [b][u]cosmetic equipment, skins, awesome mounts and pets, and consumables that give services and boosts[/u][/b], etc. However, the items will not offer special bonuses that lead to Pay-to-Win!
 
[*][b] Q. Will there be founder’s packs?[/b]
[*] A. Yes, we will be offering [b][u]exclusive founder’s packs[/u][/b] to reward our community’s continued loyalty and support. Our founder’s packs will allow you to have advanced access even BEFORE the official early access begins, and you will also get exclusive gifts depending on which pack you purchase. The final list of founder’s pack tiers will be confirmed at a later date.
[/list]
[h1]And now, for what you’ve all been waiting for… When Bless Online will be available to play on Steam![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/17851d9b8d58fd9c53bc59aa68e04e2d1a39a4a4.png[/img]
We are putting a lot of effort into the Steam version of Bless Online and we hope you will enjoy all of our work this [b][u]May 2018[/u][/b], including localization, fun content, and better performance.

So now you know the exciting news! May will be a big month for Bless Online, as you will be able to purchase founder’s packs and start playing Bless Online! 

Join us in the [url=youtube.com/watch?v=_N2L5e9_bK8]World of BLESS![/url] 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_N2L5e9_bK8
Thank you for your continued support,
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Dev Talk #01] Meet the Bless Team!
notes.content:
Greetings!

As a part of our journey to the Bless Steam launch, we would like to take a moment through this dev blog to introduce some key members of the Bless Team. These are folks that will be driving the development and the launch of Bless Steam version so we felt that our community ought to get to know them better.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/27b5035dd24bd93e0c4bd5f4d732ab9639ee7b56.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Sungjin Ko (Executive Producer)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/77c27255be18a35af696d1ae5fab51cefe51f3d2.jpg[/img] Sungjin Ko is our EP or head honcho and he basically runs both the development team and business team at Neowiz Bless Studio. He works with all teams to make sure everything is moving in the right direction. He continues to emphasize the core values of our studio every chance he gets, which is “connecting with our community.” The reason why he feels this is so important is the fact that we are creating a game for a global audience. Sungjin has asked the team to be ready to incorporate feedback from the players all over the world to make sure that Bless doesn’t feel like just a localized title but a game that was made for a global audience. We are sure you will see more of Sungjin! 

[h1][b]Jaehoon Jeon (Creative Director)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/fab12139ba0ef5b3abd591a6d894b9102402de7c.jpg[/img]
You may remember Jaehoon from our January Dev Talk where he shared the development roadmap for the team. Jaehoon wears many hats on the Bless team as the Game Director and also the Creative Director. Basically, Jaehoon is driving Bless Online’s development. To be more precise, he analyzes the flow of the game and its content. If he finds any issues, Jaehoon first creates a plan for the fix, allocate necessary resources for the update and adjust the release schedule for implementation.

[h1][b]Daeeok Park (Art Director)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/3da3b612a58841e1875430da2bc1762a21e3ba7d.jpg[/img]
Bless Online’s Art Director Daeeok Park takes inspirations from classic console titles such as  Vagrant Story, Final Fantasy Tactics and Darksiders 2. He is responsible for creating and populating the majestic world of Bless Online. He’s currently working on new concept art for the world, key characters, and classes in order to prepare the game for global audiences. He’s also creating different costumes and equipment that will be shipping with the Steam version. 

[h1][b]Kyeongho Cheon (Audio Director)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/47f375732ea6c9b5684d24fd747ef68ed7d1052f.jpg[/img]
Kyeongho Cheon has been our Audio Director from the very beginning of Bless Online! He’s in charge of all aspects of the sound you hear in Bless Online including the audio tech, in-game music, and sound effects. He wants to make sure that everything you hear in Bless Online sounds natural and balanced. Recently, he has been working hard on the localization of the voice over for the Steam version of the game for the past few months. If you turn up the volume while playing Bless, you will hear all the beautiful sounds that he and his team have created.

[h1][b]Seongil Ma (Combat Game Designer)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/2fe3170e65272e69ba1e4dae39213ac4d1dd42ed.jpg[/img]
Seongil Ma is our Combat Game Designer. He’s been hard at work thinking about how to revamp the combat from the ground up for the Steam version so our fans could find it fun. We are excited to share all his hard work with everyone soon. Our goal was nothing less than rebuilding the combat system to make it very different from the one currently in Bless Online. We will be releasing this revamp to the Steam version first and we are confident that the changes will make the wait worth it. Sungil is committed to making a user-friendly and exciting combat system.

[h1][b]Common questions[/b][/h1]

[b][u]What is your favorite content in Bless Online?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Sungjin Ko (Executive Producer)[/h1]I really like taming system in Bless, especially the fact that it’s possible to tame almost every monster that you can find in the world. It also makes the game stand out from other games in the genre. When you encounter a monster in the field, try taming it instead of killing it. Collecting the monsters as your pets can be a fun way to play the game. 
[*][h1]Jaehoon Jeon (Creative Director)[/h1]Can I have two favorites? I personally love the fact that Bless Online offers a variety of content that can be enjoyed by groups. I can party up and explore various dungeons or raid any number of field bosses in different locations. You can also take the party or guild to participate in battles between the factions My other favorite aspect of the Bless Online is the fact that you can tame many different creatures to be your pets and spawn them later. You can go hunting or do quests with your pets, which makes playing the game more exciting.
[*][h1]Daeeok Park (Art Director)[/h1]The Siege of Castra is my favorite because even though the concept is similar to other online RPGs, you get to experience massive 100 vs 100 battles in Bless.
[*][h1]Kyeongho Cheon (Audio Director)[/h1]Dungeons! Bless offers a lot of dungeons that beckons your challenge with a level of difficulty that’s neither too easy nor impossible. It definitely scratches the itch for people who love taking risks for rewards. There are hidden tips on how to clear all the stages in dungeons. I hope you find joy in uncovering these stratagems, defeat the boss and getting that sweet loot. 
[*][h1]Seongil Ma (Combat Game Designer)[/h1]Any monster that you encounter can become your mount. This mount system is probably my favorite. You can see many different kinds of monsters in Bless Online, and they can all be turned into your mounts! Also, it’s really interesting how they can grow and be used for different purposes.
[/list]

[b][u]The class/race you like to play and why?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Sungjin Ko (Executive Producer)[/h1]Union / Panthera / Berserker: I like playing Union’s Pantera race and the Berserker class the most. The reason I prefer Pantera is because to me they look cooler than the other races. I actually played the Berserker class the most so I got used to playing it! It’s one of the most dynamic classes. Also, I like how the axe, Berserker’s main weapon, is designed. I also recommend this to the newcomers because it’s a beginner-friendly class.
[*][h1]Jaehoon Jeon (Creative Director )[/h1]Amistad / Guardian: I like the image of a brave medieval knight that it portrays. The other joy of playing the Guardian class is the fact that when I play in a party, I can put myself in the front line and play as a tank to absorb lots of damage. 
[*][h1]Daeeok Park (Art Director)[/h1]Hieron / Sylvan Elf / Female Assassin: Mainly because of the fantasy-like feeling that the character and original locations give off, as well as how the character moves nimbly. 
[*][h1]Kyeongho Cheon (Audio Director)[/h1]Lupus / Berserker. I think everyone who likes action should try out this class at least once. It has just the perfect balance between exciting action and laid-back gameplay. The fact that you can lure all the monsters to one place and use various combos to catch them makes the game more fun!
[*][h1]Seongil Ma (Combat Game Designer)[/h1]Panthera / Berserker: Even though all the races and classes are great, the Berserker’s action combat style suits my play style the most and the combination looks cool when I pick the Panthera. I’d like to recommend this particular combination to the gamers out there! I’m not saying that the other races and classes aren’t as great, but this is just my preference. Go ahead and combine all the races and classes you want! I also recommend the attractive female elf and assassin combination (laughs).
[/list]

[b][u]Is there anything you want the Bless Online fans out there to know?[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Sungjin Ko (Executive Producer)[/h1]First of all, I’m glad that I’m able to speak to international fans about our game. The dev team has been working really hard to get the game ready, so we are hoping to release a good game soon. Finally, I want to address the concerns regarding Pay to Win in the game. I promise you that there will be no Pay to Win elements in Bless Online. We want players to enjoy the game their own way.
[*][h1]Jaehoon Jeon (Creative Director )[/h1]Launching a new game can be both nerve-racking and exciting for any developer. We are always racking our brains to make our in-game content even more interesting. We put so much effort into creating a game experience that you can enjoy. We hope you get to experience it and have fun. 
[*][h1]Daeeok Park (Art Director)[/h1]I hope that you can take a break from recent fads like fighting and survival games for a while so that you can enjoy playing Bless Online with your friends in a wide and beautiful fantasy world.
[*][h1]Kyeongho Cheon (Audio Director)[/h1]One of the key elements of making MMORPGs better is the continued nurturing from the community. We hope that you will help us make Bless Online a rich and fulfilling experience by making new friends, exploring and sharing together. Please enjoy the game!
[*][h1]Seongil Ma (Combat Game Designer)[/h1]I’m glad to be able to share my thoughts with all of you through this Dev Talk. I hope I’ll have this opportunity to do this again.
[/list]
The adventure is just beginning for the Bless Team. Even though we might be far away from you, we will make sure we continue to open our ears and doors for you. We will be listening to your feedback closely and work with you to improve Bless Online together. Keep a close eye on the official communities to stay up to date on all the great new stuff that’s coming soon

Thank you
The Bless Team

notes.title: [Dev Talk] 2018 Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello! It feels like only yesterday when we last greeted everyone, we can’t believe it’s already been three months. Time sure flies! 

This week we are finally able to present to you the first “[b]Dev Talk[/b],” where we hope to officially address some things that you have all been curious about regarding Bless Online’s Steam service. Starting with today’s Dev Talk on Steam development, we plan to continually publish Dev Talks about development progress, concerns, and detailed plans. We hope you will enjoy them!

We are extremely grateful that so many of you are looking forward to Bless, and are bringing up points of concern because of your interest and enthusiasm for Bless. Since we pay great attention to the community, you can rest assured that we are well aware of what everyone is most curious about! While we cannot answer ALL of your questions immediately, we hope to answer some of them and also satisfy your curiosity through the Dev Talk series.


[h1][b]Interview with the Game Director – Bless Online Development Roadmap[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/391540042aa80a26de3e4f9b65d607adc3529d01.jpg[/img]

Our new Game Director knows Bless better than anyone else! Jae-hoon is also the one who guides the future development direction and points of focus for Bless. Recently, he presented a big development roadmap regarding Bless Online’s Steam release. We thought that it would be a good idea to share this with you guys so we asked him for an interview.

[list]
[*][h1]Q Jae-hoon! Please tell us about the development direction for Bless Online in 2018.[/h1]

[*]A. First, I want to say how happy I am to be able to meet everyone through Dev Talk. While we were deciding on and preparing for Bless Online’s Steam service, I thought that the most important thing was to be clearly aware of Bless’ strengths and points for improvement when deciding on the big picture for development.

Therefore, we tried to find Bless’ strength and weaknesses by looking back on our past service experiences through various kinds of research, such as NA/EU community feedback and focus group interviews. Using this as our foundation, we ended up deciding on the development direction after much consideration.

To summarize Bless Online’s development direction for 2018: we aim to fix problems that many have identified as we lead up to Steam Early Access. We want to ensure smooth gameplay and develop and polish new and current content to allow players to experience Bless’ transformation. In the long run, we will present new core content that expresses Bless’ strengths and uniqueness.

Of course, as we aim to launch Steam EA as soon as possible, we may be criticized for trial and error during the development progress. However, we think that communication with players and providing quick responses is the most important thing in game service. Thus, we will make and grow Bless Online together as we listen to the feedback of players in North America and Europe.

We will do our best to improve on all Bless’ shortcomings before Steam Early Access!

[*][h1]Q According to the above direction, what is the most important feature in the Steam version that you are currently improving?[/h1]

[*]A. As I mentioned above, as part of our short-term goals, we are currently focusing on the development of four components that will transform Bless before Early Access. 
- [b]Growth[/b]: in addition to providing further vertical growth for players, we want to provide goals for horizontal growth (exploration of new content rather than just leveling upwards, etc) while minimizing repetitive experiences
- [b]Optimization[/b]: provide a pleasant gaming environment 
- [b]Combat[/b]: break away from repetitive combat patterns, making combat fun and rhythmic   
- [b]UI/UX[/b]: provide an intuitive and unified UI that creates a positive user experience

In the first build that will be unveiled on Steam, we will present you the new Bless, including the growth, improved optimization, and noticeable changes in the improvement of combat and UI/UX. 


[*][h1]Q Can you please tell us about the main content that is under development and in particular, provide detailed examples regarding combat?[/h1]

[*]A. To give you a brief description of what we’re developing: We are redesigning the arrangement and connection structure of the game content to improve the flow, and we are revising the game guide as a whole. We will also improve the current UI / UX to make it easier for players to understand what is going on in the game without any inconvenience.

Combat is the area we focus on the most because it comprises of the majority of gameplay. However I am confident that you will feel considerable change in Bless’ combat as we have been working very hard to improve it.

The main goal of the combat change is to make a system of rhythmic combat that is fun in regard to skill building, and battling solo or with party members.

In order to provide tempo-based (rhythmic) combat, we are re-adjusting the monster difficulty and adding skill combo effects for more efficient and interesting combat. Additionally, with the skill customization system, a skill’s effect or the whole impact of the skill itself can be changed depending on the path you choose. It will definitely provide more depth to growing skills and will enable more strategic combat in PVE / PVP situations.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30966189/58e7439006e00bdecf92dbdbab667b92dc83a12c.jpg[/img]

The current skill system works through players improving their skills by investing skill points, but in the future players will be able to diversify their combat style by choosing which skill effects to grow and how to make their skill combos.

In addition, the cooperative aspects will be more interesting with the addition of special buff effects that vary depending on the party members’ classes.

We are also preparing a lot of other content not mentioned above, and we will share further details on improvements through later Dev Talks.

[b]Lastly, many fans in the community are wondering about the release schedule. There will be a chance to tell you what you are looking for soon.[/b]

Everyone in our company is working hard to develop the game you would like in EA, so please be patient and give us a little more time!
[/list]

Thank you
The Bless Team
